question: By what mode of perfect fusion and turning back does this power operate on all sides?
premises: The power acts by the nature of perfect fusion.
The same power operates through turning back.
This operation extends on all sides.
inference: This power functions universally through inward reversal grounded in perfect fusion.
uncertainties: The exact referent of sā+eṣā depends on the immediately preceding verses.
plain_english: By the nature of perfect fusion, this same power, through turning back, operates on all sides.
